summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, to correct an inadvertent reference in its proxy statement for the Annual General Meeting scheduled for June 16, 2026. The correction clarifies the expiration date of Chairman Mark Germain's services agreement, which aligns with his director term expiring at the second annual meeting after the current meeting. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. It is a routine administrative correction to a meeting notice. No deal terms are present.
